project_identity.name: RotaFlow BH - Maps Clone para Técnicos de Campo
project_identity.target_audience: Técnicos de campo, motoristas de serviço e gestores de frota em Belo Horizonte

fixed_base.address: Rua Descalvado 636, Renascença, Belo Horizonte - MG
fixed_base.name: Base Operacional Renascença

project_identity.brand_voice: Alta precisão, comandos táteis velozes, visual tático de centro de comando urbano sem copiar branding do Google

colors.theme: Dark Mode & Light Mode dual-toggle with Tactical Dark as default for navigation comfort

rules.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum for normal text, 3:1 for large stats).
rules.hover_states: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).

layout_and_responsive.file_extension_notice: CRITICAL: The codebase uses React JavaScript files (.js), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Maintain standard JS component structure.

desktop.layout_structure: Split View with left collapsible floating glass sidebar (width: 420px) + full-bleed 3D Map viewport
sidebar_components: Header with Brand Logo (RotaFlow), search input with Places Autocomplete, theme toggle, and user profile / logout button
Base operational card showing Rua Descalvado 636, Renascença - BH
Draggable/Reorderable Stops List with reorder handles, remove buttons, and status indicator
Action Bar: 'Otimizar Ordem das Paradas' button, 'Adicionar Parada' button, and 'Calcular Rota'
Route Alternatives Comparison Panel (Distance in km, Duration in mins, Toll estimated cost R$, Traffic status)
Saved Routes (Roteiros Salvos) list with quick load buttons

mobile.layout_structure: Full-screen Map viewport with overlay elements: Floating Top Maneuver Banner (when navigating), Floating Bottom Sheet with expandable drawer, Recenter Floating Action Button, Tilt 3D Toggle, Navigation Controls
bottom_sheet_states: Collapsed (preview ETA, next stop name, start navigation button)
Fully-expanded (complete route management, leg details, alternatives)

map_features_and_google_apis.engine: Google Maps JavaScript API Vector Map with fallback rich simulated Vector Map canvas when API key is pending or offline
map_controls: Map Mode Switcher: Mapa Vetorial, Satélite HD, Visão 3D Terreno/Edifícios, Camada de Trânsito ao Vivo
Compass & Tilt Rotation (0° to 45° tilt slider/button)

features: Real-time routing polylines with traffic-colored segments (Green/Yellow/Red)
Comparative alternative routes rendered with dashed gray overlays
Toll calculation display (Estimativa de Pedágios R$)
Leg-by-Leg details with distance and travel time per segment
Stops Order Optimization engine (TSP heuristic / Google Directions optimizeWaypoints)
Live simulated GPS movement following route polylines at controllable speed (1x, 2x, 5x)
Next maneuver top banner: Turn icon (Left, Right, Keep Right, Roundabout, U-turn, Straight), distance to maneuver (e.g., 'Em 200m'), street name (e.g., 'Vire à esquerda na Av. Cristiano Machado')
Bottom ETA Bar: Total remaining distance (km), total remaining time (min), estimated arrival clock time (e.g., 'ETA 14:35'), progress bar
Off-route detection simulation & automatic re-routing trigger ('Recalculando rota...')
Navigation state actions: Pausar, Retomar, Avançar para Próxima Parada, Voltar à Visão Geral
Destination reached congratulatory modal with summary stats

patterns: Side panel slide in/out: initial={{ x: -400, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ x: 0, opacity: 1 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25 }}
Maneuver Banner drop down: initial={{ y: -100, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }}
Route drawing effect: Animated SVG polyline path length reveal
Interactive list item drag & drop reordering animation with spring transition
Destination Arrival Celebration Modal scale-up entrance with confetti or pulse effect
Skeletons for route loading state and search autocomplete results

login_screen.title: Acesso RotaFlow BH
login_screen.subtitle: Sistema de Navegação e Otimização para Técnicos
login_screen.features: Validation, error toast, remember session simulation, default quick-login button ('Entrar como Técnico Exemplo')

auth_and_state.no_os_module: DO NOT create any Order of Service (OS) management modules or tickets. Keep strict focus on Map, Route Optimization, Stop Management, Saved Routes, and Turn-by-Turn GPS Navigation.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_policy: MANDATORY: All buttons, inputs, tabs, map controls, stop items, maneuver banners, and status badges MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read /app/design_guidelines.json completely before writing front-end code.
Ensure all components use standard JavaScript (.js) syntax as configured in the project.
Implement Google Maps API script loader with graceful fallback if window.google is unavailable or API key is not configured, providing a seamless interactive mock vector map.
Always include data-testid on interactive elements for reliable automated testing.
Set fixed base address as Rua Descalvado 636, Renascença, Belo Horizonte - MG as the default starting origin.
